_comment: UC-SM-02 Spending Detective. Tone rule: the leak is never described as greed or stupidity. Twenty rupees is genuinely nothing — the surprise is only what it becomes when multiplied, and that surprise is the whole lesson.
hook: You had money at the start of the month. You have very little now, and you cannot point at a single thing you bought.
prompt: Go through the month. Which of these happened again and again, and which happened once?
summary: You found where the money actually went.

chart.title: Where it went
chart.small_total: The small, repeated ones came to {amount}.
chart.guess: You thought the small things were about {amount}.

leak.title: The biggest repeat
leak.annual: {name} is {monthly} a month. Over a year that is {annual}.
leak.rank_prompt: Put these in order, biggest drain first.
leak.pick: Pick one to cut back on — not stop, just halve.
leak.projection: Halving {name} saves {saved} over the next {months} months.
leak.nothing: Nothing here repeats enough to be a leak. That is genuinely good.

concept.tracking: Small amounts do not feel like spending, so they never get counted. Counting them is the only way to see them.

simulated: Every payment here is made up for this game. Nothing is read from your phone.
